description: This file defines a PushRegistrationManager actor responsible for managing push notification registration payloads, including relay and direct transport configurations, and handling related encoding, validation, and network interactions.

classes.name: PushRegistrationManager
classes.description: Actor class that manages creation and registration of push notification payloads for relay and direct transports.

classes.name: PushRelayGatewayIdentity
classes.description: Struct representing the identity of a relay gateway with device ID and public key.

methods.name: makeGatewayRegistrationPayload
methods.description: Creates a registration payload string for push notifications, either relay or direct based on the build configuration.

methods.name: makeRelayPayload
methods.description: Generates a relay-specific registration payload, performing validation and network registration as needed.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Determines whether a relay handle has expired based on its expiry timestamp.

methods.name: sha256Hex
methods.description: Computes the SHA256 hash of a string and returns it as a hex string.

methods.name: normalizeTokenSuffix
methods.description: Normalizes a token suffix string by trimming whitespace and lowercasing.

methods.name: encodePayload
methods.description: Encodes an Encodable object into a JSON string.
